document.cue: Describe a job you would like to do in the future.

text: I'd like to talk about a job I'd love to do in the future, which is working as a conference interpreter. At the moment I'm still a student, but I've been interested in this profession ever since I attended an international forum in my city and saw interpreters working in small glass booths.

To become an interpreter, I'd first need to finish my degree in translation and then get some practical experience, probably by working as a volunteer at events. After that, I'd have to pass professional exams and perhaps do a master's abroad. The skills required are quite demanding. You need excellent command of at least two languages, of course, but also a good memory, the ability to concentrate for long periods and to stay calm under pressure, because there's no time to look up a word when someone is speaking. I'm already working on these skills by practising shadowing with TED talks every morning.

The main reason I'd like this job is that it combines my two passions: languages and meeting new people. Every day would be different, as I'd be working on topics from medicine to politics, so I'd never get bored. It's also a well-paid profession, which is obviously a bonus. Although it can be stressful, I'd rather have a challenging career than a routine one, so I'm determined to make this dream come true.

tips.en: I'd need to and I'd have to are natural forms for plans.
tips.kk: I'd need to, I'd have to — жоспарға тән табиғи формалар.
tips.ru: I'd need to, I'd have to — естественные формы для планов.
tips.example: I'd first need to finish my degree in translation

tips.en: Although and as clauses show grammatical range.
tips.kk: Although және as бағыныңқылары грамматикалық ауқымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Although и as-придаточные показывают грамматический диапазон.
tips.example: Although it can be stressful, I'd rather have a challenging career than a routine one

tips.en: Professional wording like command of languages adds precision.
tips.kk: Command of languages сияқты кәсіби сөздер дәлдік береді.
tips.ru: Профессиональные слова вроде command of languages придают точность.
tips.example: You need excellent command of at least two languages

note.en: Names the job and explains where the interest came from.
note.kk: Мамандықты атап, қызығушылықтың қайдан шыққанын түсіндіреді.
note.ru: Называет профессию и объясняет, откуда возник интерес.

note.en: Outlines the route to the job and required skills, plus current steps.
note.kk: Мамандыққа апаратын жолды және қажетті дағдыларды, сондай-ақ қазіргі қадамдарды сипаттайды.
note.ru: Описывает путь к профессии и необходимые навыки, плюс текущие шаги.

note.en: Explains motivation and ends with determination.
